title: Anyone can block single signature DKIM recoveries
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as the user won't be able to recover access to his wallet  **Likelihood:** High, as anyone can execute this attack by front-running a recovery  ## Description  In `DKIMRecoverySigValidator` there is a mechanism for single signature recoveries. The catch is that if you use it, you will have to have a timelock on your recovery, which is a predefined number (should be set in `AccInfo.onlyOneSigTimelock`).
